USB OCP Recovery

Absolute Address:

Source:

Description

USB transport OCP Secure Firmware Recovery v1.1 register aperture. OCP command fields follow OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 command summaries, with USB-specific live-status behaviors aligned to usb_ocp_recovery_regs.sv and usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv.
